title: documents/1 — one document row of the Connect `documents` dataset (data_pull)
description: v0.1.83 (C373 second-brain lead, 2026-10-27; packages lead review points a-g applied). Producer: connect (data_pull dataset `documents`): MCP accounts (MCP resources/list + resources/read), database accounts (one table page rendered as CSV per row), later Composio Drive/Notion/Gmail. Consumers: observer (read-only ingest + normalisation; C322(6) ingest = Observer only), knowledge/foundry via Observer deliveries. The account is the data_pull scope instance of the request (the row carries no account); consumers dedupe on (account, collection, id) and keep the row with the newest `rev`. Text is untrusted input (APP-11(f)): `untrusted` is always true; control, bidi and zero-width characters MAY remain in `text` and consumers strip them before display or indexing; producers remove NUL. HTML sources are converted to text/markdown by the producer (no text/html rows). Extra members are allowed and ignored (L24). A source deletion arrives as a row with deleted: true, empty text and title "" (or the last title).

id.description: stable source id (MCP resource uri, `<schema>.<table>:<page>` for a table page)

collection.description: folder / channel / table the document belongs to; the unit an owner shares and an app picks

path.description: human path, e.g. `Acme LLC/Finance/Q3 board memo`

url.description: https link to the original, when the source has one

rev.description: content version; changes when text changes (etag, sha256 of text, or row-version)

handle.description: canonical normalizeHandle form (`<channel>:<value>`) when the source maps to one, else the raw source string with raw: true

kind.description: hint for normalisers; `table` = CSV of rows with a header line

text.description: ≤ 262,144 code points; the page stays ≤ 2 MiB UTF-8 (the producer pages by bytes; 50 rows is a ceiling, not a promise)

truncated.description: text was cut to the 262,144 code point cap

page.description: data_pull answer for dataset documents: ≤ 50 rows, ≤ 2 MiB (S-7).
